The '''Raid on Pantolomin''' took place during the [[Thrawn campaign]]. It allowed [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] to gain the location of the mythical [[Katana fleet|''Katana'' fleet]].

==Prelude==
In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] visited the ''[[Coral Vanda]]'' while searching for information about the [[Katana fleet|''Katana'' fleet]]. They wanted to meet [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hoffner]] who discovered the fleet [[6 BBY/Legends|years before]].

But [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] had also discovered the identity of Hoffner and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] had sent [[Niles Ferrier]] to capture him.

==The Battle==
Han Solo and Lando Calrissian didn't meet Hoffner because Ferrier and his [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] had already caught him. Solo and Calrissian tried to free him but the ''Coral Vanda'' was forced to surface and surrender due to the [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] bombardment of the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']]. [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] immediately boarded the ship forcing Solo and Calrissian to escape in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape craft]].

==Aftermath==
Niles Ferrier delivered Hoffner to Grand Admiral Thrawn who was able to convince, financially to not lose time, the captain to give him the coordinates of the ''Katana'' fleet.

[[Talon Karrde]] later gave the coordinates to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in order to avoid Thrawn retrieving the fleet. However, due to political discussions in the [[New Republic Provisional Council]], the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Navy]] was too slow to stop Thrawn. Thrawn eventually managed to [[Battle for the Katana fleet|secure]] almost all the fleet.
